Company website describes itself as a 'Global Manufacturer and Exporters of Tyres' with four plants in Gujarat and a 'Global Presence' section, but no destination list, customs record, B/L or contract naming Russia/CIS was retrievable (the /global-presence/ page returned HTTP 404). Status: not confirmed either way.
note: Risk-only scope. Sanctions: could NOT be positively screened — OFAC Sanctions List Search is a JavaScript form returning no results via plain HTTP GET, and the search backend was down, so no SDN/UN/EU/UK/BIS entity-list query could be executed. sanctions_hit is therefore null = 'not verified', NOT 'clear'. Recommend re-running a name screen on OFAC/EU/UK/BIS before onboarding. Court record (Indian Kanoon, 6 hits): all matters are tax/revenue (Central Excise 2015 CESTAT and 2016 Gujarat HC; ITAT Ahmedabad ITA 145/AHD/2026, AY 2017-18) plus a Gujarat HC liquidation matter where the company appears as the BUYER of a third party's (Hindustan Cotex Exports Ltd.) assets — no insolvency, winding-up or criminal case against the company itself was found. Per project rules these are not rejection grounds and are noted neutrally: 'есть сложности'.
